{
 "cells": [
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "# Prediction (out of sample)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 1,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-29T16:24:32.039477Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-29T16:24:32.039238Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-29T16:24:33.353727Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-29T16:24:33.345349Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "%matplotlib inline"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-29T16:24:33.358493Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-29T16:24:33.358079Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-29T16:24:35.948460Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-29T16:24:35.946386Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "\n",
    "import statsmodels.api as sm\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.rc(\"figure\", figsize=(16, 8))\n",
    "plt.rc(\"font\", size=14)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Artificial data"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 3,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-29T16:24:35.952342Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-29T16:24:35.951147Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-29T16:24:35.959447Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-29T16:24:35.957821Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "nsample = 50\n",
    "sig = 0.25\n",
    "x1 = np.linspace(0, 20, nsample)\n",
    "X = np.column_stack((x1, np.sin(x1), (x1 - 5) ** 2))\n",
    "X = sm.add_constant(X)\n",
    "beta = [5.0, 0.5, 0.5, -0.02]\n",
    "y_true = np.dot(X, beta)\n",
    "y = y_true + sig * np.random.normal(size=nsample)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Estimation "
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 4,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-29T16:24:35.963060Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-29T16:24:35.962004Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-29T16:24:35.982732Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-29T16:24:35.981137Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "                            OLS Regression Results                            \n",
      "==============================================================================\n",
      "Dep. Variable:                      y   R-squared:                       0.985\n",
      "Model:                            OLS   Adj. R-squared:                  0.984\n",
      "Method:                 Least Squares   F-statistic:                     986.8\n",
      "Date:                Thu, 29 Oct 2026   Prob (F-statistic):           9.67e-42\n",
      "Time:                        16:24:35   Log-Likelihood:                 3.1273\n",
      "No. Observations:                  50   AIC:                             1.745\n",
      "Df Residuals:                      46   BIC:                             9.394\n",
      "Df Model:                           3                                         \n",
      "Covariance Type:            nonrobust                                         \n",
      "==============================================================================\n",
      "                 coef    std err          t      P>|t|      [0.025      0.975]\n",
      "------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
      "const          5.0982      0.081     63.119      0.000       4.936       5.261\n",
      "x1             0.4834      0.012     38.803      0.000       0.458       0.508\n",
      "x2             0.4896      0.049      9.997      0.000       0.391       0.588\n",
      "x3            -0.0184      0.001    -16.865      0.000      -0.021      -0.016\n",
      "==============================================================================\n",
      "Omnibus:                        0.448   Durbin-Watson:                   2.270\n",
      "Prob(Omnibus):                  0.799   Jarque-Bera (JB):                0.531\n",
      "Skew:                          -0.206   Prob(JB):                        0.767\n",
      "Kurtosis:                       2.709   Cond. No.                         221.\n",
      "==============================================================================\n",
      "\n",
      "Notes:\n",
      "[1] Standard Errors assume that the covariance matrix of the errors is correctly specified.\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "olsmod = sm.OLS(y, X)\n",
    "olsres = olsmod.fit()\n",
    "print(olsres.summary())"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## In-sample prediction"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 5,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-29T16:24:35.985175Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-29T16:24:35.984899Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-29T16:24:35.992209Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-29T16:24:35.990816Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "[ 4.63707354  5.10090082  5.52665589  5.88765797  6.16685525  6.35962644\n",
      "  6.47454001  6.53194644  6.56063468  6.5931022   6.66021578  6.78614016\n",
      "  6.98436784  7.2555023   7.58715887  7.95599947  8.33156702  8.68128942\n",
      "  8.97583107  9.19391264  9.32580716  9.3749382   9.35731731  9.29891345\n",
      "  9.23138627  9.18688462  9.1927645   9.2670946   9.41568763  9.63114534\n",
      "  9.89407401 10.17627079 10.44535735 10.67009954 10.82553908 10.89709415\n",
      " 10.8829551  10.7943818  10.65385369 10.49137644 10.3395521  10.22822272\n",
      " 10.17956734 10.20445805 10.30067375 10.45326505 10.63701043 10.82056006\n",
      " 10.97158648 11.0620959 ]\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "ypred = olsres.predict(X)\n",
    "print(ypred)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Create a new sample of explanatory variables Xnew, predict and plot"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 6,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-29T16:24:35.995510Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-29T16:24:35.994507Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-29T16:24:36.002978Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-29T16:24:36.001496Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "[11.06354347 10.93628591 10.69952206 10.39700356 10.08632303  9.82481327\n",
      "  9.65551031  9.59661659  9.63704443  9.73913065]\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "x1n = np.linspace(20.5, 25, 10)\n",
    "Xnew = np.column_stack((x1n, np.sin(x1n), (x1n - 5) ** 2))\n",
    "Xnew = sm.add_constant(Xnew)\n",
    "ynewpred = olsres.predict(Xnew)  # predict out of sample\n",
    "print(ynewpred)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Plot comparison"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 7,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-29T16:24:36.006367Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-29T16:24:36.005357Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-29T16:24:36.288198Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-29T16:24:36.287549Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "<matplotlib.legend.Legend at 0x7533ccff6cf0>"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 7,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    },
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 1600x800 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "\n",
    "fig, ax = plt.subplots()\n",
    "ax.plot(x1, y, \"o\", label=\"Data\")\n",
    "ax.plot(x1, y_true, \"b-\", label=\"True\")\n",
    "ax.plot(np.hstack((x1, x1n)), np.hstack((ypred, ynewpred)), \"r\", label=\"OLS prediction\")\n",
    "ax.legend(loc=\"best\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Predicting with Formulas"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Using formulas can make both estimation and prediction a lot easier"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 8,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-29T16:24:36.291437Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-29T16:24:36.291152Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-29T16:24:36.303238Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-29T16:24:36.301563Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "from statsmodels.formula.api import ols\n",
    "\n",
    "data = {\"x1\": x1, \"y\": y}\n",
    "\n",
    "res = ols(\"y ~ x1 + np.sin(x1) + I((x1-5)**2)\", data=data).fit()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "We use the `I` to indicate use of the Identity transform. Ie., we do not want any expansion magic from using `**2`"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 9,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-29T16:24:36.306624Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-29T16:24:36.305349Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-29T16:24:36.315526Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-29T16:24:36.313939Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "Intercept           5.098223\n",
       "x1                  0.483364\n",
       "np.sin(x1)          0.489563\n",
       "I((x1 - 5) ** 2)   -0.018446\n",
       "dtype: float64"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 9,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "res.params"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Now we only have to pass the single variable and we get the transformed right-hand side variables automatically"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 10,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-29T16:24:36.319016Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-29T16:24:36.317931Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-29T16:24:36.328867Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-29T16:24:36.327342Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "0    11.063543\n",
       "1    10.936286\n",
       "2    10.699522\n",
       "3    10.397004\n",
       "4    10.086323\n",
       "5     9.824813\n",
       "6     9.655510\n",
       "7     9.596617\n",
       "8     9.637044\n",
       "9     9.739131\n",
       "dtype: float64"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 10,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "res.predict(exog=dict(x1=x1n))"
   ]
  }
 ],
